title: Drill the shared fallback runner: coded descents for generate_with_fallback
deviations_from_card: No test(...) commit before the feat commit: the tests were written first and run red (23 of 27 new cases; the 4 green are guard cases pinning what must NOT change), but committing them alone would have been a red commit, so tests and implementation landed together in 4771dcc46 (each commit green). Write-set growth within the allowance: test_devcase_cli.py and test_agentfit.py (the CLI acceptance case lives beside its CLI's tests), and docs/architecture/llm-provider-layer.md, docs/features/dev-case/README.md and docs/features/pipeline/README.md (coupled docs the critic said the Stop hook would name; edited under the docs lock, committed alone). test_fault_injection.py and fault-injection.md's generated table needed no change. automation.py gained one behaviour change beyond the aliases: rematch now names a coerced-away rationale 'unusable_output' - adding rematch to REASONED_TASKS exposed that wrong_shape still degraded anonymously there (match_reasoning.generate returns deterministic without calling on_fallback when _coerce backfills).
notes: Card acceptance 8 of 8 (was 0 of 8). Drill rows 210 -> 240 (10 modes x (21 task rows + 3 seams)), all held; drill wall-clock unchanged (~23s, dominated by LightTrack egress timeouts from the local .env, same before and after). test:eval:ci green before and after (matching 8/12 with 4 report-only FAILs is identical on base). monitor's recorded 'maintained apart on purpose' decision is overturned in code (llm/degradation.py docstring + monitor.py comment) and in the commit body: FAILURE_REASONS is kept as its own name and is now a checked strict subset of DEGRADATION_REASONS. fallbackCode still rides on the intake and jobseeker artifacts (their modules pop only fallbackReason and were outside the write set); the TS side projects both wires field by field (intake-run.ts, jobseeker-run.ts), so it never reaches the browser, but a later card could pop it in intake.py / jobseeker.py. baseline.py only puts result into a frozen seat when it has files, which the deterministic template never has, so no frozen seat carries the code. tsc exit 2 is entirely foreign: every error is under the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (0 errors elsewhere); I touched no TS. test:perf exit 1: every overage line is a TS import-graph ceiling (app/page.tsx, llm-config.ts, job-ingest.ts, ~9 api routes) - this card changed no TS, so they come from sibling builders' TS work (uncommitted app/_lib/devcase-run.ts, repo-snapshot.ts, github/client.ts, devcase-authenticity.ts at the time of the run, plus sibling commits). Slot B (wave 3) inherits fault_eval.py: the per-row judgement is now the shared _judge(), items come from _drill_items(), and seam rows carry scenario='fixture'.
